strings.When OneDrive moves your Desktop, Docume: When OneDrive moves your Desktop, Documents, or Pictures into the cloud it often leaves a local copy behind, so “where is my Documents?” has two answers. Automatic follows Windows (cloud where it moved them, local otherwise). Local prefers your %USERPROFILE% copy; OneDrive prefers the OneDrive copy — each falls back to the other when its copy doesn’t exist, so a shortcut never opens to nothing.
strings.When on (the default), the report below,: When on (the default), the report below, the bundle you can save, and the activity trail all replace every file and folder name with “…”. We see only the shape of what you did — how deep a folder was, what file type — never the names. So you can share a report with us and we learn nothing about your files. Turn it off only if a maintainer asks for real paths to reproduce a bug.
strings.When on, opening a folder from your Favo: When on, opening a folder from your Favorites doesn't count toward its Ant Trail heat or add it to Recents — so deliberate shortcuts don't crowd out folders you actually browse to. Reaching the same folder any other way still counts.
